text:
Samira: Quick heads-up: PR #4899 lands a new Console quickstart page with a compact "latency SLO" widget preset, a short migration note for the tracing key rename, and updated SDK snippets for Node/Python/Go. Need a docs owner to run linkcheck and confirm numbers. cc @DevEx Leo @Infra Raj
DevEx Leo: I can pick this up. Paste the staging preview?
Samira: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/4899/preview. What changed: new widget (latency-slo + cost-breakdown band), small rewrite of tracing examples to use the canonical `trace_id` key, and a tiny prefetch visualization example. Also fixed a couple of anchors.
Infra Raj: Runtime v2.2 includes a compatibility shim that accepts the old `traceKey` name but we should recommend users migrate their dashboards/alerts to `trace_id`. Add a note about agents <2.2 needing manual edits.
Maya (product): Can we include a concise before/after measurement box instead of a big table? PMs prefer a single-line summary for the quickstart. Suggested copy: "Example (illustrative): median 110ms -> 88ms, p99 270ms -> 230ms, est cost/request $0.0047 -> $0.0040" with a short caveat.
DevEx Leo: Running smoke + linkcheck: `./scripts/docs-smoke.sh --pr 4899 --suite quick --linkcheck`
audit-bot: deploy queued: docs-staging 4899 -> staging (ETA ~2m)
DevEx Leo: Smoke passed. Linkcheck: 1 broken anchor in deep-dive (tracehook#legacy). Leaving PR comment.
Samira: I'll patch the anchor and add a redirect note pointing to the new trace-key migration subsection. Also adding minimal migration snippets mapping old->new keys across SDKs.
DevEx Leo: Snippet suggestions look good. For Go, please show context.Value -> span.SetTag mapping; for Node keep single-line examples.
Infra Raj: Microbench summary I'm dropping into the PR: median latency improved ~20%, p99 down ~15%, token cost per request down ~9%. Adding a short one-line result under the widget doc and a pointer to the eval notebook for folks who want to reproduce.
Maya (product): Add a one-line checklist near the top: 1) Upgrade SDKs to v3.5+ for auto-mapping; 2) If on older SDKs, replace `traceKey` -> `trace_id`; 3) Repoint alerts/alerting queries.
Samira: Patch applied, redirect added, snippets included (Node/Python/Go), microbench numbers added, and PR updated with the preview refresh.
DevEx Leo: Re-ran linkcheck -> all green. Approved pending CI.
audit-bot: deploy finished: docs-staging 4899 -> staging (status: success)
Samira: Merged to main and added a short changelog entry for the Console quickstart. Backported the migration note to the 3.x docs set. Closing thread  thanks everyone! :tada:
